goal: Allow users to disable periodic transaction rebroadcasts without also disabling initial broadcasts
Prevent privacy leaks where periodic announcements to all peers reveal wallet ownership of transactions
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Author pushed a rework to preserve default rebroadcasting behavior and extend -walletbroadcast
Past objection to disabling rebroadcasts by default has not yet been formally withdrawn (achow101)
Objected that turning rebroadcasts off by default harms user convenience (vicjuma)
Open suggestion to disable artificial mempool resubmission if rebroadcast is disabled (mzumsande)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because periodic rebroadcasting to all connected peers leaks wallet transaction ownership
Provides privacy-conscious wallet users a way to prevent these leaks without disabling initial sends
